title: eludite.view.resize output
description: The sizes in effect after the command: the dock's size, and for a group resize the shares of every group on that edge in order.

size.description: The dock's width (left, right) or height (bottom), logical pixels, after clamping.

shares.description: Each group's share of the dock's length, top to bottom (left, right) or left to right (bottom); they sum to 1.
